description:
The fleet through LangChain4j's extension points on any JVM host: the
    fleet's AgentCards as a ToolProvider, discovery and data tools, a take
    lease renewed per model round-trip and carried across threads, chat
    memory in a replicated space, model access as a fleet service
    (interoperable with the Spring AI and Micronaut model services), real
    embeddings for semantic discovery, and fleet-wide token usage.
